_doc: Testnet mark vaults of the leverage series (QuadrixIndexVault, deployed with deposit cap 0 by keeper/deploy-mark-vault.mjs). Not part of the rulebook: a vault displays the level, it is not the rule. address null = no vault (marks skipped); gate null = the owner has not chosen the mark gate (marks skipped). gate {"mode":"step"} marks in steps inside the contract bound, never stopping on size; {"mode":"halt","pct":15} stops the marks when the move exceeds pct and waits for a person.
